What importing a WebAssembly module fails with: compiling, the names it may
not use, linking its imports, its start function, cycles that reach a
binding before it is initialized, and source phase imports.

-- bad.wasm.bin --
not wasm
-- empty.wasm.bin --
-- js.mjs --
export const f = 1;
export const g = 5;
export const tab = 5;
-- t01.mjs --
import "./bad.wasm";
-- t02.mjs --
import "./empty.wasm";
-- m.wat --
(module (func (export "add") (param i32 i32) (result i32) local.get 0 local.get 1 i32.add))
-- t03.mjs --
import { nope } from "./m.wasm";
-- notcallable.wat --
(module (import "./js.mjs" "f" (func)))
-- t04.mjs --
import "./notcallable.wasm";
-- missing.wat --
(module (import "./js.mjs" "h" (func)))
-- t05.mjs --
import "./missing.wasm";
-- jsprefix.wat --
(module (import "wasm-js:x" "f" (func)))
-- t06.mjs --
import "./jsprefix.wasm";
-- nameprefix.wat --
(module (import "./js.mjs" "wasm:f" (func)))
-- t07.mjs --
import "./nameprefix.wasm";
-- exportprefix.wat --
(module (func (export "wasm-js:f")))
-- t08.mjs --
import "./exportprefix.wasm";
-- start.wat --
(module (func $s unreachable) (start $s))
-- t09.mjs --
import "./start.wasm";
-- mutable.wat --
(module (import "./js.mjs" "g" (global (mut i32))))
-- t10.mjs --
import "./mutable.wasm";
-- table.wat --
(module (import "./js.mjs" "g" (global i32)) (import "./js.mjs" "tab" (table 1 funcref)))
-- t11.mjs --
import "./table.wasm";
-- self.wat --
(module (import "./self.wasm" "f" (func)) (func (export "f")))
-- t12.mjs --
import "./self.wasm";
-- tdz.mjs --
import { g } from "./tdz.wasm";
export function f() {}
export const seen = typeof g;
-- tdz.wat --
(module (import "./tdz.mjs" "f" (func)) (global (export "g") i32 (i32.const 1)))
-- t13.mjs --
import "./tdz.wasm";
-- a.wat --
(module (import "./b.wasm" "g" (func)) (func (export "f")))
-- b.wat --
(module (import "./a.wasm" "f" (func)) (func (export "g")))
-- t14.mjs --
import "./a.wasm";
-- t15.mjs --
import source x from "./js.mjs";
-- t16.mjs --
await import.source("./js.mjs");
-- t17.mjs --
await import.source("./bad.wasm");
-- t18.mjs --
await import.source("./jsprefix.wasm");
-- nodep.wat --
(module (import "./nowhere.mjs" "f" (func)))
-- t19.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import source x from "./nodep.wasm";
p("source of a module whose imports are not there", () => x instanceof WebAssembly.Module);
-- t20.mjs --
await import("./nodep.wasm");
-- t21.mjs --
import "./bad.wasm";
-- t22.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
const x = await import.source("./nodep.wasm");
p("import.source of a module whose imports are not there", () => x instanceof WebAssembly.Module);
-- want --
t01.mjs -> CompileError: $DIR/bad.wasm: WebAssembly.Module(): expected magic word 00 61 73 6d, found 6e 6f 74 20 @+0
t02.mjs -> CompileError: $DIR/empty.wasm: WebAssembly.Module(): BufferSource argument is empty
t03.mjs -> SyntaxError: "$DIR/m.wasm" does not export "nope"
t04.mjs -> LinkError: WebAssembly.Instance(): Import #0 "./js.mjs" "f": function import requires a callable
t05.mjs -> LinkError: WebAssembly.Instance(): Import #0 "./js.mjs" "h": function import requires a callable
t06.mjs -> LinkError: Invalid Wasm import "wasm-js:x" in $URL/jsprefix.wasm
t07.mjs -> LinkError: Invalid Wasm import name "wasm:f" in $URL/nameprefix.wasm
t08.mjs -> LinkError: Invalid Wasm export name "wasm-js:f" in $URL/exportprefix.wasm
t09.mjs -> RuntimeError: unreachable
t10.mjs -> LinkError: WebAssembly.Instance(): Import #0 "./js.mjs" "g": imported mutable global must be a WebAssembly.Global object
t11.mjs -> LinkError: WebAssembly.Instance(): Import #1 "./js.mjs" "tab": table import requires a WebAssembly.Table
t12.mjs -> LinkError: WebAssembly.Instance(): Import #0 "./self.wasm" "f": function import requires a callable
t13.mjs -> ReferenceError: cannot access "g" before it is initialized
t14.mjs -> ReferenceError: cannot access "f" before it is initialized
t15.mjs -> SyntaxError: the module "$DIR/js.mjs" has no source to import
t16.mjs -> SyntaxError: the module "$DIR/js.mjs" has no source to import
t17.mjs -> CompileError: $DIR/bad.wasm: WebAssembly.Module(): expected magic word 00 61 73 6d, found 6e 6f 74 20 @+0
t18.mjs -> LinkError: Invalid Wasm import "wasm-js:x" in $URL/jsprefix.wasm
source of a module whose imports are not there -> true
t19.mjs -> ok
t20.mjs -> Error: Cannot find module '$DIR/nowhere.mjs' imported from $DIR/nodep.wasm [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]
t21.mjs -> CompileError: $DIR/bad.wasm: WebAssembly.Module(): expected magic word 00 61 73 6d, found 6e 6f 74 20 @+0
import.source of a module whose imports are not there -> true
t22.mjs -> ok
